mechanism: Metronidazole may potentiate tranylcypromine's MAOI effects and increase risk of hypertensive crisis; both drugs can cause CNS effects and metronidazole has potential disulfiram-like properties that may interact with MAOI metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution under close monitoring; consider alternative antibiotics; monitor blood pressure and CNS symptoms closely if co-administration is necessary.
